systems.country_label: ISO 27001 (international standard; operator certificate covering sites in seven countries including Congo)

note: No fact: the operator's blog announces an ISO 27001 certificate from an unnamed 'accredited certification body', not shown to be in-country, and no national standards body or national standard is mentioned; a company's certificate is class other.
Telecom quality-of-service rules and formal notices from the regulator ARPCE (class other); no national standards body, IT or data standard or certification stated.
Telecom quality-of-service directives from the regulator ARPCE before the 2026 elections (class other); no national standards body, IT or data standard or certification stated.
SIM registration compliance by the regulator ARPCE (class other); no national standards body, IT or data standard or certification stated.
SIM registration deadline set by the regulator ARPCE (class other); no national standards body, IT or data standard or certification stated.

facts.fact: The ISO member page says ACONOQ was created by Law No. 19-2015 of 29 October 2015 as the national standardization body, managing the national standards register.
facts.system: Agence Congolaise de Normalisation et de la Qualité (ACONOQ)

note: ISO 9001 quality management certificate from Bureau Veritas, not an IT standard and not a national standards body.
